title: The Brand Gap
subtitle: How to Bridge the Distance Between Business Strategy and Design

verification.method: Web check of title/author/publisher/year against publisher or library records
verification.notes: ISBN-13 is the original 2003 New Riders edition; the 2005 revised edition is 9780321348104. Also confirmed via Open Library and Internet Archive.

summary: A compact argument that brand is 'a person's gut feeling about a product, service, or company,' bridged from strategy to design through five disciplines: differentiate, collaborate, innovate, validate, cultivate.
